during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Leave us.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Your presence is not desired.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.player: But I need your help! I was sent by Asteros Arceuus, son of Lord Trobin Arceuus.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Arceuus.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: The name of a liar.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.npc: They came to us. Two of them.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: The brother and the husband.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.npc: Her time was running out. They wanted to give her more.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: We granted them knowledge. To give her more time.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: But they misused it. And the world suffered.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: In a way. But it was not meant for that.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Time was what it was meant for. But time still runs out.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.npc: They put an end to time. They endangered the balance.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: For every death, there must be life.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.npc: For every life, there must be death.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Perfectly balanced.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: As all things should be.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: For without balance, the world burns.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.player: You're very confusing, you know that right?

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Perhaps.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.npc: Perhaps our knowledge is beyond your understanding.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.player: Well thankfully I didn't come here for knowledge. I came here for help. The Dark Altar is failing and the people of Arceuus are in danger. I need you to help me find the cause.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: The people of Arceuus have had their time.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Why should we help them?

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.player: sigh* It can never be easy can it.
Fine. If you help me save the people of Arceuus, then I will help you.
I've done this enough times to know that everyone wants something, even the masters of life and death.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Interesting. Maybe the human is not as stupid as it looks.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.player: Well I've been known to have my moments.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Very well human.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: We admit, the Arceuus people do have their uses.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.npc: Their work with souls has been useful in helping to maintain the balance.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: We will help them. But first, you will serve us.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.player: Excellent. What do you need from me?

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.npc: To the south lies a battlefront.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: There is a grave there. Within it lies a soul, trapped inside a corpse.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Free this soul. In return, we will provide our help.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.player: So you just want me to kill a zombie?

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: A zombie is soulless. An empty shell, reanimated by magic.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: This is a soul. Trapped in this world, when it should have long departed.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.npc: Its existence is an affront to the balance.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Which is why it falls to you.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: Consider it a test.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.text: We may have further use for you.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-first-encou.player: Hmmm. Very well, I'll go and free this soul.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.player: I've dealt with the trapped soul.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.npc: And now we shall help you.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.text: While you were busy, so were we.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.text: We have found the cause of your problem.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.npc: You said the Altar was failing.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.text: The Altar is fine, but its power has been redirected.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.text: To a construct built by a mortal.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.player: So I just have to go to the Dark Altar, find this device and then destroy it. Sounds easy enough.

during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
during-the-ascent-of-arceuus-after-freei.text: Then you have what you need.

steps.player: Tell me about yourselves.
Balance? So you serve Guthix?
What power?
Why do you serve this power?

steps.npc: The anima of this world, it is fed by life.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: Without life, there is no anima.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
steps.text: But life can also destroy. It can endanger the anima.

steps.npc: So life must be kept in check.

steps.player: And you were given this purpose?

steps.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
steps.text: Our purpose was to wait. But we saw the world burn.

steps.npc: We could not stand by and watch.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: So we left our people. Left our home.

steps.npc: And took on a new purpose.

steps.player: I'm still not sure I understand.

options.text: Why did that soul need freeing?

steps.player: Why did that soul need freeing?

steps.npc: Upon death, a soul should leave this world.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: And move to the one beyond.

steps.player: Was it always there?

steps.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
steps.text: The body was of one who died a long time ago.

steps.npc: But the soul was of one who died more recently.

steps.player: Is this something that often happens?

steps.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
steps.text: We believe a mortal to be involved.

steps.player: Interesting...

options.text: You said you might have further use for me?

steps.player: You said you might have further use for me?
What did you mean by that?

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: Another could have filled your role.

steps.player: You said it was an important task. Now you say it's a menial one. Which is it?

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: An important task can still be menial.

steps.player: Hmmm... If you say so.
So why was it only a small task? Surely saving the Arceuus people was worth more than that.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
steps.text: You assume it was a trade.

steps.player: But you said I had to do it to save them?

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: We had already committed to saving Arceuus.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
steps.text: But we needed time to determine the problem.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: While we worked, you needed purpose.

steps.player: I feel a little bit used.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
steps.text: Then you should have paid more attention.

steps.player: So what is the further use you have for me?

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: But we will call on you again.

options.text: Why do you hate Lord Arceuus?

steps.player: Why do you hate Lord Arceuus?
Them? Who else was there?
Another?
I can see we're not going to get anywhere here.
Goodbye.

options.text: What do you know of Xeric?

steps.player: What do you know of Xeric?
Right... sorry. What was it you called him? The great betrayer?
But why? What did he do?
Plenty of people threaten the balance. Why was he especially bad?
What are you hiding? You call him a betrayer... Did he betray you? Did you work with him?

options.text: Do you know anything about this rogue Pyromancer?

steps.player: Do you know anything about this rogue Pyromancer?
So you know nothing of them?

steps.npc: More than many of the others.

steps.player: They sound dangerous. What do you plan to do?
Nothing?

steps.npc: The Doors of Dinh are safe.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Ket-Jor
steps.text: They can do no more harm.

steps.player: But whoever they are, they're working with Xamphur. Many lives could be at risk.

steps.npc: But the balance is what matters.

steps.speaker: Kaal-Mej-San
steps.text: There is no need for action.

options.text: Why do you hate Lord Arceuus?
